items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: And you could still hear it, even though he had the band, a good sized band, twelve pieces.

ctx.x: Well, I, I knew a little about the work already, see, so I went right on up there, went to work. And I did all this, the linen clothes, you know, shirts and all the linen clothes. And I stood up there and worked good well. And I, I, I even turned down jobs. You stayed there? I mean, uh, uh, uh, working places where, they wanted me to work over there regularly. On, uh, Iperville Street when they had that little nightclub, and I wouldn't go over there. I said, well, I'm doing all right where I'm at. You see? I…

items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I had a picture when I was playing with Senator Desby, I can't find.

ctx.x: No. In those days they didn't get the publicity. No radio or television like they would have now to put a group over.
I had a picture when I was playing with Senator Desby, I can't find. That's what I was looking for.
Well, someday maybe we'll come across it and then we can make copies of some of those things, too. It's nice, that WPA group is nice.
